title: ABU DHABI
description: Modern luxury villa façade featuring clean white GRC cladding panels with minimalist architectural lines and large full-height glazing. The project highlights precision installation, seamless joint finishing, and contemporary exterior detailing, creating a sleek and elegant waterfront residence aesthetic.

title: Belresheed Tower
description: Supply and installation of GRC Pigmented Stone Finish Cladding, comprising factory-produced GRC panels with integral color pigmentation and stone-textured finish, including all necessary fixing systems, accessories, and complete installation.

title: Dubai Design District Hub
description: Parametric GRC screen wall system generated from Grasshopper — 2,400 unique panel geometries produced via CNC moulds to ±1 mm tolerance.

title: King Abdullah Financial District
description: Structural UHPC facade panels for a 72-storey commercial tower — panels span 5.4 m with no secondary steel frame, cutting programme time by 6 weeks.

title: Bahrain Bay Waterfront
description: Ornamental GRG column casings and coffered ceilings across a luxury hotel lobby — 0.5 mm surface tolerance enabling seamless paint and gold-leaf finish.

title: YS2 C27 - Mayyas at the Bay
description:
Supply and installation of architectural GFRC façade elements for Mayyas at the Bay project in Abu Dhabi.
The scope includes curved balcony fascias, horizontal architectural bands, decorative façade profiles, and custom molded GFRC elements designed to achieve a modern and seamless architectural appearance.

The project was executed with high-quality finishing standards, ensuring durability, smooth surface texture, accurate alignment, and compliance with project specifications and consultant requirements.

title: Grand Mosque Cultural Wing
description: Ornamental GRG facade screen with hand-cast Islamic geometric lattice panels across three monumental arched bays. Each panel replicates historic Mashrabiya patterning at 0.5 mm surface tolerance — fabricated in our Sharjah facility and installed on-site in 22 days.
